content.rendered:
Packets with back to school information will be mailed home to families the week of August 14th.  Please watch for those to arrive in your mailbox.  


Registration Open House at Laurel Ridge Middle School

●    
August 22nd: 
4:00 – 7:00 pm

●    
August 23rd:  
9:00 – 2:00 pm

6th grade families and families new
to LRMS should plan to attend registration on the evening of August 22nd if
possible.  Volunteers will be available
this night to help students with lockers, pick out PE clothing and answer any
questions. Our counselors and administrators will also be onsite.  Please be aware that lines are the longest
from 4:00 – 5:30 pm.   

If you are new to Sherwood School District you must fill out paperwork prior to attending the registration open house.  Please contact our office at 503-825-5800 if you have any questions.
